items.title: Esther Dupuy Breckenridge Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: I never have remembered, even at the patio raw where most of our, you know, a lot of the debutante parties where we mostly had Pierron and Celestine.

ctx.x: And, you have all your life been going to the same debutante parties? Yes. And you've been all the time at the parties that did...

I never have remembered, even at the patio raw where most of our, you know, a lot of the debutante parties where we mostly had Pierron and Celestine. There might have been a time there where they had a few white bands, but if so, I wasn't conscious of it. You know, I mean, they weren't very good in my opinion and I don't even remember them.

What about, you know, the friends interested in it are other people who, do you know it's among white New Orleans interesting to be maintained throughout the years, during the 30s and the 40s? Whether they wanted it to remain? Mm-hmm. Well, I'd like to listen to it because they preferred to work for the rap because they were somewhat small communities.
